data.narrative:
Xona Space Systems is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $281M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comparable universe of five public equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and eight private peers, with particular focus on three same-stage, same-sector private comparables: Sierra Space ($8.0B), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B), and Skyryse ($1.1B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier to the $281M raised proxy, implying a $478M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector Series C companies yields a $1.5B implied valuation, with the peer set ranging from $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue. The analysis does not contemplate the 6-company public sector median of 26.4x P/S without internal revenue data.

The triangulated range is $406M (low), $989M (median), and $1.7B (high), anchored by two methodologies. Key uncertainties center on revenue trajectory, capital efficiency relative to stage-peers, and whether the company profiles closer to the lower-valuation peers (Skyryse, Varda) or the higher outlier (Sierra Space). Additional disclosure of revenue or near-term commercial milestones would narrow this $1.3B spread materially.
